item.title: Moving database stores (docker/PostgreSQL)
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
Moving a PostgreSQL data store for a Docker contained server

I had to free up space on the primary OS drive, one target was to take the PostgreSQL Docker container and reconfigure to store its persistent data directory on a dedicated external volume (~HOME/data/).

item.title: Using Docker for R
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
I had partitioned my development environment such that I had virtual machines providing:

  • R and R-studio
  • A PostgreSQL server
  • A development machine

This basically avoided some package clashes when “tinkering”. There is however some clumsiness (I need lots of PostgreSQL clients all over the place). So the current cunning plan is to run some of this inside Docker.
